name: cross-platform-general-reference-fidelity
coverage_domains: photographs with people, objects, or environments
illustrations with stylized shapes or surfaces
flat graphics and posters with text or solid fills
complex subjects with openings, overlaps, attachments, or occlusion
simple images where some profile dimensions are not applicable

material: Represent only visible grain, roughness, gloss, thickness, folds, stretch, wear, or other surface properties.
Generic realism or high-detail wording must not replace observable material attributes.
Flat or textureless sources must not receive invented microtexture.
structure: Preserve identity-defining geometry, openings, overlaps, attachments, connection points, and asymmetry.
Do not replace a complex subject with a conventional category-level shape.
visibility: Preserve which parts are visible, adjacent, cropped, or occluded and which object causes each occlusion.
Do not force visibility or occlusion that the source does not show.
composition: Preserve subject scale, crop, pose or orientation, negative space, and depth order.
Do not standardize an informal, asymmetric, close, distant, or otherwise source-defining composition.
Keep exact source dimensions separate from the normalized generation ratio; preserve the same normalized canvas fact in every platform adapter.
light_and_color: Preserve light direction, value structure, color temperature, and visible reflections.
Preserve source-relative hue, lightness, saturation, and saturation ranking for every applicable major region.
Keep local color relationships distinct from unsupported global color casts.
text_and_graphics: Preserve legible source text exactly and retain its hierarchy, location, and alignment.
Do not invent unreadable text, graphics, or unsupported surface effects.

platform_expectations.gpt: Use complete relationship-aware instructions with constraints beside affected objects, beginning with normalized canvas ratio and reliable source-size reference.
platform_expectations.grok: Use compact instructions without collapsing required structural zones or depth layers, beginning with a compact canvas and source-size clause.
platform_expectations.midjourney: Front-load composition and P0 geometry, then source-defining color and material, using only conservative supported parameters and a normalized compact --ar.

pass_criteria: All requested platform-language variants retain every applicable high-drift invariant from one shared visual fact source.
Profiles are conditional: absent texture, text, people, depth, or saturation attributes are marked not applicable rather than invented.
Positive description defines correct structure, material, visibility, composition, and color; negative constraints do not replace it.
Validation checks each fidelity dimension independently.
The final Markdown output contract and source-image persistence behavior remain unchanged.
